body: The secrets-pipeline port (to retire the 741-line secrets_build.go copied in sync_go and volt-api) adds only generic primitives: selection flags, bundle, file-valued secrets, export dialects. Nothing about GITHUB_SECRET_, ENV_B64, KEY_FILES or act is hardcoded; each project composes flags in its own Taskfile. Selection lives once in the core Source pipeline so github, vercel and future verbs share identical semantics.
title: Mechanisms in dotenvctl, conventions in the consuming project
